Problem Statement:
You are given an array A containing N distinct positive integers. Let A[i] represent an element in A. Mr. Beckham wants to perform an operation on the elements of A. He wants to choose a positive integer X and perform A[i] := A[i] mod X for all i (1 <= i <= N). Help Mr. Beckham choose the smallest possible value of X such that the elements of the array remain distinct even after performing the operation. (It can be proven that an answer exists for all possible inputs)
